hero.intro: A hands-on cooking class hosted by Stacy and Noah in their kitchens in San Francisco and Napa. Cook global, plant-forward dishes side by side with friends, then sit down to share the meal you made together.
hero.photo_description: Baskets of strawberries, apricots, plums and figs at a farmers’ market
hero.caption: Gain an interest in global foods, one recipe at a time.

mission.heading: Two things *bring us to the table*

aims.title: Teach people how to be creative with plants
aims.text: We show you how to turn everyday vegetables, grains, and legumes into bold, global dishes, so plant-forward cooking feels inspiring, never limiting.

aims.title: Building community
aims.text: Every class gathers a Crew of 6 around one table, turning a shared, plant-based meal into lasting connections and new friendships.

what_to_expect.heading: An afternoon in *three courses*
what_to_expect.intro: Every class is a Crew: a group of 6 friends, family, or colleagues who cook, laugh, and eat together.

steps.title: Cook together
steps.text: Pair up and take on one recipe per pair, with Stacy guiding every chop, simmer and taste.

steps.title: Share the meal
steps.text: Every pair brings their dish to the table, and together it becomes a full plant-forward feast.

steps.title: Leave inspired
steps.text: Go home with the recipes, new techniques, new ingredients, and a fresh way of seeing what plants can do.

purpose.heading: A plant-forward *teaching kitchen*
paragraphs: We guide you through a plant-forward teaching kitchen featuring interactive storytelling, designed to enhance both personal and professional performance.
Our goals are simple: learn to re-imagine plants, create a flavorful experience, and most importantly, have a great afternoon with friends and friends to be.
benefits: Understand that not all vegan options are healthy
Learn the impact of nutrition on longevity and performance

pillars.name: Healthy Lifestyle
pillars.intro: Armed with scientific and medical facts to fuel and inspire your journey toward healthy living.
pillars.question: What are the essential choices for healthy living?

choices.title: You are what you eat
choices.text: A balanced diet rich in nutrients from a variety of foods supports overall health and reduces the risk of chronic disease.

choices.title: Water
choices.text: Staying well hydrated is essential for maintaining bodily functions, sharpening cognitive performance, and supporting overall well-being.

choices.title: Sleep
choices.text: Adequate sleep is crucial for physical recovery, mental clarity, and a healthy metabolism.

choices.title: Exercise & balance
choices.text: Regular physical activity, combined with rest and balance in life, builds strength, supports heart health, and promotes mental well-being.

outcomes: Understand lean eating and a plant-forward diet
See clearly what vegan and vegetarian eating truly entails
Know the difference between eating for weight loss and eating for performance
Weigh the benefits of healthy aging and disease prevention against relying on medication

pillars.name: Healthy Eating
pillars.intro: A collection of delicious and nutritious recipes featuring unique alternatives that show what a healthy vegan diet truly entails.
pillars.quote: Vegan? Ohhh… that can’t taste good.
pillars.question: What are the “ingredients” for healthy eating?

choices.title: Nutritious experiments
choices.text: Trying new recipes and food combinations makes eating exciting.

choices.title: Patience & persistence
choices.text: Healthy eating habits take time and consistent effort.

choices.title: Healthy choices, healthier living
choices.text: Conscious decisions about what you eat can significantly improve your well-being and quality of life.

choices.title: Focus on taste
choices.text: Delicious, satisfying meals keep healthy eating a pleasure you can sustain.

outcomes: Personalize your diet with informed objectivity

pillars.name: Healthy Relationships
pillars.intro: A demonstration of how cooking techniques can enhance teamwork, leadership, and overall relationship-building skills.
pillars.quote: Pause, simmer, adjust, listen, and you will improve.
pillars.question: Where else can the benefits be observed?

choices.title: Focus
choices.text: A nutrient-rich diet supports brain health, sharpening focus and concentration for better listening and teamwork.

choices.title: Agility
choices.text: Nutrient-dense foods improve physical health and agility, helping you act quickly and effectively.

choices.title: Decision making
choices.text: A diet rich in omega-3s and antioxidants boosts cognitive function and supports better decisions.

choices.title: Taking risks
choices.text: Good nutrition supports mental clarity and emotional stability, building the confidence to take calculated risks.

recipes_section.heading: From our *kitchen* to yours
recipes_section.intro: Plant-forward dishes from our classes, with new recipes added regularly. Each one comes with its story, step-by-step directions, and Stacy’s notes, so you can cook along at home.

steps.title: Reach out
steps.text: Tell us about your Crew.  Talk to Stacy directly about available dates.   We will plan the experience together.

steps.title: Get the recipes
steps.text: Before class you will receive a welcome note, the recipes, and everything you need to know about arrival.  It is encouraged to read the recipes ahead of time - the beginnings of Mis-en-place.

steps.title: Share any dietary needs
steps.text: Let us know about allergies or restrictions in advance so everyone can enjoy the meal safely.

steps.title: Cook, then gather
steps.text: Arrive, meet Stacy and Noah, pair up, and cook. Then sit down together , "break bread" for the meal you created.

steps.title: Gather feedback
steps.text: After class, we will ask you to complete a quick 5 question survey.  Stacy wants to hear what you loved, what can be improved, from the food to the cooking, so every experience keeps getting better.

faq.question: Do I need any cooking experience?
faq.answer: Not at all. Every recipe is broken down step by step, from mise en place to plating, and we are right there with you the whole time.

faq.question: Who is the experience for?
faq.answer: Groups of friends, families, teams, and anyone curious about plant-forward cooking. Each group cooks together as its own Crew, which makes it a wonderful setting for celebrations and team building.

faq.question: When do classes meet?
faq.answer: Classes typically meet on Thursdays at 4:00 PM. If another day works better for your Crew, just ask.

faq.question: Is everything vegan?
faq.answer: Yes. Every dish is plant-based, and we love showing skeptics just how flavorful plants can be.

faq.question: Can you accommodate allergies?
faq.answer: Please tell us about any allergies or dietary restrictions when you book, and we will plan the menu around them.

faq.question: Where do classes take place?
faq.answer: In our home kitchens in San Francisco and Napa. Let us know which you prefer, and we will share the address and arrival details with your Crew once your date is confirmed.

faq.question: Is there a fee?
faq.answer: No.  This is our contribution to creating community and paying it forward.
